# CLI reference

FunScript 0.2.3. This page is generated from [the CLI command catalogue](../../src/cli/commands.ts).

## Commands

### `funscript build`

```text
funscript build <file.fun|file.funx...> [--target bun] [--out <file>] [--outDir <dir>] [--sourcemap] [--no-check] [--no-ts] [--no-global-this] [--bare-pipelines] [--no-deep-destructure] [--bin] [--watch] [--engine <auto|bun|esbuild>] [--fast]
```

Build FunScript files to TypeScript or TSX in dist/ by default, or bundle one entry and its local modules as a Bun executable.

```sh
funscript build src/Button.funx --sourcemap
```

```sh
funscript build src/cli/bin.fun --target bun --out dist/cli/bin.js
```

### `funscript emit`

```text
funscript emit <file.fun|file.funx> [--out <file.ts|file.tsx>] [--sourcemap] [--no-ts] [--no-global-this] [--bare-pipelines] [--no-deep-destructure] [--bin] [--prettier]
```

Compile one FunScript file to TypeScript or TSX.

```sh
funscript emit src/main.fun --out src/main.ts --sourcemap
```

### `funscript check`

```text
funscript check [file.fun|file.funx...] [--fix] [--idiomatic] [--json|--sarif] [--warnings-as-errors] [--no-ts] [--no-global-this] [--bare-pipelines] [--no-deep-destructure]
```

Statically type-check files with the TypeScript API, optionally fix formatting and pipeline styles, and emit machine-readable diagnostics.

```sh
funscript check examples/shapes.fun
```

```sh
funscript check src/ --fix
```

```sh
funscript check src --sarif --warnings-as-errors
```

### `funscript tsc`

```text
funscript tsc [TypeScript options]
```

Run the project's TypeScript compiler and map type-view diagnostics to FunScript sources.

```sh
funscript tsc --noEmit
```

### `funscript run`

```text
funscript run <file.fun|file.funx> [--no-check] [--no-ts] [--no-global-this] [--bare-pipelines] [--no-deep-destructure] [--engine <auto|bun|esbuild>] [--fast] [-- arg... ]
```

Bundle and run a FunScript program and its local imports with Node.js.

```sh
funscript run examples/hello.fun
```

```sh
funscript run src/main.fun -- --verbose
```

### `funscript test`

```text
funscript test [filters...] [--watch] [--run] [--engine <vitest|bun>] [--coverage] [--ui] [--reporter <name>] [--no-check] [--fast]
```

Run unit and integration tests across FunScript (.fun/.funx) and TypeScript modules.

```sh
funscript test
```

```sh
funscript test tests/native-funscript.test.fun
```

```sh
funscript test --watch
```

```sh
funscript test --engine bun
```

### `funscript init`

```text
funscript init [directory] [--template <template>] [--force]
```

Scaffold a new FunScript project with configured scripts, dependencies, and examples.

Aliases: `new`.

```sh
funscript init my-app
```

```sh
funscript init my-server --template bun-server
```

```sh
funscript init my-ui --template vite-react
```

```sh
funscript init --template vite-solid
```

### `funscript repl`

```text
funscript repl
```

Start the interactive REPL.

```sh
funscript repl
```

### `funscript lsp`

```text
funscript lsp [--stdio]
```

Start the Language Server Protocol server.

```sh
funscript lsp --stdio
```

### `funscript fmt`

```text
funscript fmt <file|directory|glob...> [--check|--diff] | fmt --stdin [--check|--diff] [--stdin-filepath <path>]
```

Format FunScript files, directories or globs; check formatting, show a unified diff, or format source from standard input.

```sh
funscript fmt 'src/**/*.fun' --diff
```

```sh
funscript fmt --stdin --stdin-filepath src/main.fun
```

### `funscript doctor`

```text
funscript doctor [--json]
```

Check project prerequisites and FunScript configuration.

```sh
funscript doctor --json
```

### `funscript explain`

```text
funscript explain [topic] [--list] [--json]
```

Display reference documentation, syntax, and examples for a language keyword, construct, effect, or operator.

```sh
funscript explain
```

```sh
funscript explain effect
```

```sh
funscript explain match
```

```sh
funscript explain schema
```

```sh
funscript explain --list
```

### `funscript doc`

```text
funscript doc [files or directories...] [--outDir <dir>] [--format <html|markdown|json>] [--open] [--json]
```

Generate documentation and interactive API reference from FunScript source files and doc comments.

```sh
funscript doc
```

```sh
funscript doc src/ --outDir docs/html
```

```sh
funscript doc --format markdown --outDir docs
```

```sh
funscript doc --open
```

### `funscript pipeline-style`

```text
funscript pipeline-style <bare|qualified> <file or directory...>
```

Convert pipeline stages while preserving compiler output.

```sh
funscript pipeline-style bare src/
```

### `funscript version`

```text
funscript version
```

Display the FunScript version.

Aliases: `-v`, `--version`.

```sh
funscript version
```
